title: Sanitize release evidence packaging
summary: Replace an operational screenshot containing private machine details with sanitized text proof and exclude raw evidence screenshots from portable releases.
reason: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W13-001. The default portable package included a binary screenshot containing operator, host/share, local-path, process, run, and timestamp identifiers while binary media bypassed the text content scanner.
behavior_before: The tracked CSV-rerun PNG was included in portable releases, and release policy had no general exclusion for raw image evidence below ops/release/evidence/.
behavior_after: The repository keeps a sanitized, content-scanned proof under docs/testing instead of the raw PNG, and release policy excludes common raw screenshot formats below ops/release/evidence/ with matching hygiene assertions.
tests_added: Raw PNG and case-varied JPEG release evidence receive the privacy exclusion reason.
Release hygiene rules require raw PNG/JPEG evidence to be absent.
Sanitized Markdown evidence remains included and content-scan eligible.
manual_validation: Built payload/manifest proof passed: sanitized Markdown present and hash-identical, raw screenshot and raw evidence images absent, manifest lists only sanitized proof.
Change index, changelog, targeted summaries, project index, and feature map regenerated.
Direct policy assertions and PowerShell parser checks passed.
Focused release package policy suite passed.

Full release build with -Verify -IncludeTests completed in 926.9 seconds; package-local tool integration and end-to-end smoke passed, while the global gate retained known generated/active-doc/Ruff/downshift baselines and exited 1.
Generated project and feature map checks passed; global summary drift remains at the same three unrelated files.
Isolated release package removed after inspection.
Raw PNG deletion and sanitized-proof privacy scan passed.
Strict worktree coverage passed with 1,174 valid packets.
rollback_plan: Revert the policy/test/text-evidence changes and packet metadata together. Do not restore the raw screenshot unless it is redacted and independently reviewed for all operator, topology, path, process, run, and timestamp identifiers.
notes:
The original screenshot was visually reviewed before removal. Pre-removal identity: 190,276 bytes; SHA-256 dbc75c46c993f25cb1af8cef1c92c2fd0d15fd5eee3c4a22de75d20d111d2218; Git blob 1cff32e0ce638863da92573abb77d260de7058a7. Immutable audit evidence is unchanged. No media-processing behavior or source media is touched, and representative real-media validation is not required. Full release self-test is required because the release exclusion boundary changes.
Replaced private screenshot with sanitized text proof and excluded raw evidence images from portable packages.
IncludeTests-wide identifier scan also found unrelated existing source/test fixture literals; packet acceptance was scoped to the audited screenshot evidence surface.
